fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 6 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: At border control you may also need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo también puede que le pidan un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: At border control, you may also need to show a return or onward ticket.

entry.en: There is a departure tax of 86 East Caribbean dollars or 33 US dollars.
entry.es: Hay una tasa de salida de 86 dólares del Caribe Oriental o 33 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: There is a departure tax of 86 East Caribbean dollars or 33 US dollars.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si procede de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 East Caribbean dollars or more must be declared.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 dólares del Caribe Oriental o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 East Caribbean dollars or more.

safety.en: The crime rate is low, but walking alone away from the main roads, particularly after dark, could put you at risk.
safety.es: La tasa de delincuencia es baja, pero caminar solo lejos de las carreteras principales, sobre todo de noche, podría suponer un riesgo.
safety.quote: The crime rate in Dominica is low, but you could be at risk walking alone away from the main roads, particularly after dark.

safety.en: There is no recent history of terrorism in Dominica, but attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No hay historial reciente de terrorismo en Dominica, pero no se pueden descartar atentados.
safety.quote: Although there’s no recent history of terrorism in Dominica, attacks cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Protests and demonstrations sometimes occur in Dominica.
safety.es: A veces se producen protestas y manifestaciones en Dominica.
safety.quote: Protests and demonstrations sometimes occur in Dominica.

safety.en: The main highway from Douglas Charles Airport is prone to landslides after bad weather and has sheer drops where the road has fallen away.
safety.es: La carretera principal desde el aeropuerto Douglas Charles es propensa a corrimientos de tierra tras el mal tiempo y tiene precipicios donde la calzada se ha desprendido.
safety.quote: The main highway from Douglas Charles Airport is prone to landslides after bad weather and there are sheer drops where the road has fallen away.

safety.en: The hurricane season normally runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes normalmente va de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season normally runs from June to November.

safety.en: Attitudes towards the LGBT+ community are mostly conservative and certain same-sex sexual acts are illegal.
safety.es: Las actitudes hacia la comunidad LGBT+ son mayormente conservadoras y ciertos actos sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales.
safety.quote: Attitudes towards the LGBT+ community are mostly conservative throughout the Caribbean. Certain same-sex sexual acts are illegal.

health.en: Private medical treatment in Dominica can be expensive.
health.es: El tratamiento médico privado en Dominica puede ser caro.
health.quote: Private medical treatment in Dominica can be expensive.

health.en: The government hospital in Roseau can cope with many treatments, but serious cases may require emergency evacuation.
health.es: El hospital público de Roseau puede atender muchos tratamientos, pero los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: serious cases may require emergency evacuation.

health.en: The emergency medical number is 999; ask for an ambulance.
health.es: El número de emergencias médicas es el 999; pida una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 999 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink but is sometimes drawn straight from rivers and tends to turn brown after heavy rainfall.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable, pero a veces se toma directamente de los ríos y tiende a ponerse marrón tras fuertes lluvias.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink, but since it is sometimes drawn straight from Dominica's many rivers, it has a tendency to turn brown after heavy rainfall.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 999.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 999.

help.en: The FCDO in London can be called 24 hours on 020 7008 5000 for urgent help with a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar las 24 horas al FCDO en Londres, al 020 7008 5000, para ayuda urgente por un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.

getting_in.en: Dominica has two airports, Melville Hall (Douglas-Charles, DOM) and Canefield (DCF).
getting_in.es: Dominica tiene dos aeropuertos, Melville Hall (Douglas-Charles, DOM) y Canefield (DCF).
getting_in.quote: There are two airports in Dominica, Melville Hall (Douglas–Charles Airport) (DOM IATA) and Canefield (DCF IATA).

getting_in.en: Most commercial flights land at Melville Hall.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los vuelos comerciales aterrizan en Melville Hall.
getting_in.quote: Most commercial flights land at Melville Hall.

getting_in.en: Express des Isles runs the most extensive ferry service, to Martinique and Guadeloupe on most days of the week.
getting_in.es: Express des Isles opera el servicio de ferris más amplio, a Martinica y Guadalupe casi todos los días de la semana.
getting_in.quote: The most extensive official service is operated by Express des Isles, which runs services to Martinique and Guadeloupe ferries on most days of the week.

getting_around.en: Driving is on the left side of the road and there are car rental agencies at both airports.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la izquierda y hay varias agencias de alquiler de coches en ambos aeropuertos.
getting_around.quote: Driving is on the left hand side of the road and there are various car rental agencies at both airports.

getting_around.en: Roads can be in very poor condition, with large potholes and crumbling asphalt.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras pueden estar en muy mal estado, con grandes baches y asfalto desmoronado.
getting_around.quote: Watch for large pot holes and crumbling asphalt as roads can be in very poor condition.

getting_around.en: Taxis are not metered, but there are standard fares for most destinations.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro, pero hay tarifas estándar para la mayoría de los destinos.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are not metered, but there are standard fares for most destinations.

getting_around.en: On buses and taxis, you should clearly agree the destination and price before starting the trip.
getting_around.es: En autobuses y taxis conviene acordar claramente el destino y el precio antes de iniciar el viaje.
getting_around.quote: make sure that you clearly agree to the destination and price before you start the trip.

money.en: The currency is the East Caribbean dollar (XCD), written "$" or "EC$".
money.es: La moneda es el dólar del Caribe Oriental (XCD), escrito "$" o "EC$".
money.quote: The currency of the country is the East Caribbean dollar, denoted by the symbol: "$" or "EC$" (ISO currency code: XCD)

money.en: It is pegged to the US dollar at US$1 = EC$2.70.
money.es: Está vinculado al dólar estadounidense a razón de 1 US$ = 2,70 EC$.
money.quote: It is pegged to the United States dollar at an exchange rate of US$1 = EC$2.70.

connectivity.en: Digicel is a local cellular company that provides prepaid plans for short-term visitors.
connectivity.es: Digicel es una compañía móvil local que ofrece planes de prepago para visitantes de corta estancia.
connectivity.quote: Digicel [1] is a local cellular company which provides prepaid plans for those visiting for short periods.

connectivity.en: Cable & Wireless and Orange also provide cell service.
connectivity.es: Cable & Wireless y Orange también ofrecen servicio móvil.
connectivity.quote: Cable & Wireless and Orange also provide cell service.
